# Code instructions

## Types
- Each type should have a comment describing its purpose and usage, following Go's convention for documentation comments.

## Constants
- Each constant should have a comment explaining what it represents and how it is used in the context of the codebase.
- Each constant group should have a comment describing the overall purpose of the constants in that group, in addition to individual comments for each constant.

## Variables
- Each package-level variable should have a comment describing its role and how it is intended to be used within the codebase.
- Each package-level variable group should have a comment describing the overall purpose of the variables in that group, in addition to individual comments for each variable.
